docstring: Uses interval tree subtree max_end bounds to find all reservations overlapping a target window [start, end).
signature: def find_conflicting_reservations(reservations: list[tuple[int, int, str]], query_start: int, query_end: int) -> list[str]:
ref_test:
def test_interval_tree_conflicts():
    reservations = [(60, 120, "R1"), (150, 210, "R2"), (200, 260, "R3")]
    # Query overlaps R1
    assert find_conflicting_reservations(reservations, 100, 140) == ["R1"]
    # Query overlaps R2 and R3
    assert find_conflicting_reservations(reservations, 180, 220) == ["R2", "R3"]
    # Touching intervals half-open do not overlap
    assert find_conflicting_reservations(reservations, 120, 150) == []
    # Empty query or invalid bounds
    assert find_conflicting_reservations(reservations, 150, 150) == []
